name: sheet_shots_a
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game projectile sprite sheet (battle VFX)
Subject: SIX separate thrown-weapon sprites laid out in a strict grid of 3 columns by 2 rows, one object centred in each cell, reading order left to right then top to bottom:
1. a smooth round grey-brown river pebble with a small bright highlight (a sling stone), slightly irregular, about the size of a plum.
2. a wooden arrow with a bright green feather fletching, a steel arrowhead and a pale wooden shaft, lying perfectly horizontal with the arrowhead pointing to the RIGHT.
3. a four-pointed steel ninja shuriken seen from the top, bright polished steel with a round hole in the middle and sharp bevelled edges, a cold blue-white glint.
4. a wine-bottle cork seen from the side, golden tan cork texture with speckles, a short cylinder lying horizontal (a cork bullet), the rounded front end to the RIGHT.
5. a moonlit silver arrow lying perfectly horizontal pointing to the RIGHT: a shaft of pale silver-white light, a bright silver arrowhead shaped like a small crescent moon blade, pale blue-white feathers, a soft cool moonglow around it.
6. a shiny gold coin seen from the front, round with a raised rim and an embossed cat paw print in the middle, warm yellow-gold with a bright specular highlight.
Style: hand-painted 2D game VFX sprites for a polished mobile game: bold readable silhouettes that still read when shown 50 px wide, rich saturated but controlled colour, soft painterly shading with crisp highlights and a small inner glow, clean edges, NO dark outline, NO white sticker border, NO drop shadow.
Composition: all six objects the same visual weight, each fully inside its own cell with generous empty space around it, nothing touching another object or the image edge, no ground.
Background: genuinely transparent background (alpha) everywhere between the objects. No checkerboard pattern, no frame, no grid lines.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, nothing cropped.
